experiments.name: Baseline (Word-Level Seq2Seq)
experiments.description: Standard word-level encoder-decoder with limited 80-pair parallel corpus. Fails on Kannada case suffixes and compound words.

experiments.name: Technique 1: +Subword BPE
experiments.description: SentencePiece/BPE subword segmentation decomposes Kannada suffixes (-alli, -inda, -ige) and English prefixes, drastically cutting OOV.

experiments.name: Technique 2: +Data Augmentation & Back-Translation
experiments.description: Unpaired Kannada monolingual text is back-translated into English, providing +50% synthetic parallel pairs and regularizing syntax.

experiments.name: Technique 3: +Transfer & Regularization (SOTA Indic)
experiments.description: Multilingual Indic cross-lingual transfer (IndicTrans/mBART style) with label smoothing (0.1) and higher dropout (0.35) preventing small-corpus memorization.
